from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document's relevant attributes extracted from the text."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document's title or identifier (e.g., '《判决文书 7》')")
    stated_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The formal cause of action (案由) explicitly stated in the document")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="A short description of the substantive legal issue (e.g., forced demolition, compensation, etc.)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
